vocabulary.definition: a person who creates subtitles for videos or TV shows
vocabulary.example: Karli Witkowska is a talented subtitler for the show Stranger Things.

vocabulary.definition: a word that describes a noun or pronoun
vocabulary.example: The subtitler carefully chooses the right adjective to describe the scene.

vocabulary.definition: extremely surprised or shocked; unable to speak
vocabulary.example: The audience was gobsmacked by the unexpected plot twist in the movie.
The misheard lyric led to confusion among the listeners.

vocabulary.definition: spreading rapidly and widely on the internet
vocabulary.example: The funny video went viral on social media, gaining millions of views.

vocabulary.definition: to summarize or review the main points
vocabulary.example: Before the test, the teacher asked the students to recap the key concepts.
